services.value: DCLS provides a wide variety of unique laboratory testing services supporting public health, environmental protection and emergency response, performing over 9 million tests each year. Services described include clinical (human) testing for infectious disease agents and chemicals/drugs, 24/7 emergency testing for biological/chemical/radiologic agents, environmental testing for air/drinking water/recreational waters and catastrophe response, food testing for contamination and truth in labeling, and newborn screening for rare metabolic and genetic disorders.
